_about: Enforced by seedance.py before every create. Rule (Nick, 2026-11-06): spend the Seedance 2.5 resource pack only, no pay-as-you-go. --dry-run prints the verdict; --pay-as-you-go overrides it for one run.

pack._note: After buying a new pack, set tokens and expires from console.byteplus.com/finance/resource-package. While this date is in the past, 2.5 creates are blocked.
